1.0.1.title: Harbor v1.0.1 Beta
1.0.1.intro: This release adds a redesigned Season Explorer with TVDB anime support, improved split-cour anime tracking, the "More Like This" end-screen player, experimental external mpv playback and Nuvio Cloud integration, custom library groups, episode and movie release countdowns, and improvements to playback reliability, browsing performance, PublicMetaDB, games, and reader views.

sections.heading: ☁️ Nuvio Cloud & Accounts (Experimental)
items: Nuvio Cloud Integration: Added Nuvio as an account provider for syncing your library, watch progress, profiles, and addons. Connect and switch between Stremio and Nuvio under Settings → Account → Account provider (@glpc-blaze).

Cloud Profiles & PIN Protection: Added support for up to six Nuvio cloud profiles with server-side PIN protection and per-profile Continue Watching. Manage profiles under Settings → Account → Profiles (@glpc-blaze).

Profile Mapping & Synced Addons: Choose which Nuvio profile slot syncs with your Harbor profile and view its synced addons under Settings → Account → Nuvio → Profile mapping / Synced addons, available when Nuvio is selected (@glpc-blaze).

Secondary Profile Permissions: Added controls for allowing secondary profiles to manage accounts, switch providers, add profiles, and configure startup preferences. Configure these from the primary profile under Settings → Account → Profiles → Privileges for secondary profiles (@glpc-blaze).

Account-Isolated Progress & Libraries: Improved isolation of Continue Watching, resume points, watched status, libraries, and profile PINs across accounts and profiles, while preserving library changes made during synchronization (@glpc-blaze).

Safer Account Switching: Prevented stale background sync requests from overwriting the active account's watchlist or discarding cached playback progress after switching accounts (@glpc-blaze, @thunderhawkk).
Account Settings Accessibility: Kept account-provider controls reachable in Settings and clearly marked Nuvio as experimental (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 📺 Season Explorer & TVDB
items: Redesigned Season Explorer: Overhauled Season Explorer with larger, consistently sized posters, centered captions, hover-scrolling for long titles, and hover-only carousel navigation arrows (@comet776).
TVDB Anime Season Explorer: Added TVDB Season Explorer support to anime overview pages, unifying season browsing across anime and regular TV series (@comet776).
Season Number Pills & English Names: Added clear season number badges and standardized English season titles while preserving localized synopses (@comet776).
Multi-Tier Artwork Fallbacks: Season artwork now gracefully falls back from TVDB to TMDB, and finally to the main show poster if season art is missing or fails to load (@comet776).
Localized Season Synopses: Season descriptions now follow your chosen metadata language, cleanly falling back to English when untranslated (@comet776).
Performance & Layout Optimization: Reduced layout overhead and eliminated unnecessary re-renders when browsing and switching seasons (@comet776).

Season Explorer Setting: The season shelf is on by default and can be turned off under Settings → Library → Metadata → Episode order → Season explorer. Anime uses Harbor's TVDB service without a key, while regular shows use your TVDB key or TMDB metadata (@comet776).
Streaming Links Beside the Overview: Moved watch-provider and streaming links beside the overview and awards on wide detail layouts (@comet776).

sections.heading: 🎌 Anime & Split-Cour Tracking
items: Cross-Cour Navigation: Fixed previous and next episode buttons failing to navigate across sequel anime cours (@comet776).
Multi-Episode ONAs as Seasons: Classified multi-episode ONAs properly as full seasons, fixing incorrect episode titles and broken special thumbnails (@comet776).
Split-Cour Continue Watching: Preserved direct episode mappings for split-cour anime in Continue Watching so progress transitions smoothly (@comet776).
Batch Mark Watched Across Cours: Marking an episode as watched now correctly marks all prior episodes up to that point, even across split cours (@comet776).
AniList Rate-Limit Resilience: Prevented AniList API rate limits from blocking or delaying anime detail pages (@comet776).
Direct Sequel Mapping: Prioritized direct addon mappings for sequel episodes, with automatic retries for missing Kitsu entries (@comet776).
More Reliable Anime Resume & Stream Matching: Preserved anime identity when resuming from Continue Watching and improved stream matching to reject releases from the wrong season (@thunderhawkk).

Verified Continue Watching Episodes: Anime Continue Watching cards retain exact add-on entry IDs and provider episode mappings, showing the correct season and episode across desktop, Big Picture, and mobile (@comet776).
Scoped Sequel Hiding: Hiding an episode now applies only to the matching sequel entry, so the same episode number in another cour stays visible (@thunderhawkk).

Multi-Episode & Sequel Navigation: Fixed next-episode navigation for anime files that contain multiple episodes and preserved sequel identity when switching to local or downloaded episodes (@thunderhawkk).
Simplified Anime Search: Removed the separate "Sequels & Prequels" search row so anime results appear without waiting on extra AniList requests (@comet776).

sections.heading: 🎬 Video Player & Playback
items: "More Like This" End Screen: When you reach the end of a movie or episode—or during a customizable lead time before it finishes—a smart recommendation screen appears with suggested titles based on TMDB and Cinemeta (@thunderhawkk).

Corner Mini-Player: While browsing suggestions before a title concludes, your current video shrinks into a rounded corner mini-player with compact play, pause, progress, and volume controls so playback is never interrupted.
Big Picture & Controller Navigation: Full D-pad and keyboard navigation support across cards, preview actions, mini-player controls, and "Keep Watching / Close" actions.

Customizable Countdown & Timing: Configure custom lead times (up to 30 minutes, with convenient presets like 5 minutes), countdown rings, and default countdown actions under Settings → Player & quality → Up next.

Play in Your Own MPV (Experimental): You can now launch and watch video streams directly inside your system's standalone mpv player (Settings → Player & quality → Engine → External player). Harbor cleanly preserves pause states, track selections, resume checkpoints, and episode titles (@momo-labsz).
Linux Picture-in-Picture (PiP): Fixed detached Picture-in-Picture window lifecycle and video restoration specifically for Linux desktop environments (@pengunnn).

Consistent Sources Between Episodes: Improved next-episode playback and queue transitions to retain your selected addon, release group, quality, and dub, including when preferred addons respond late (@thunderhawkk).
Smoother Stream Recovery: Fixed playback restart loops and improved recovery to preserve your position when a stream unexpectedly stops (@thunderhawkk).
Audio Recovery: Improved audio-device recovery so it completes before playback resumes (@thunderhawkk).
Faster Seek-Bar Previews: Reduced thumbnail preview latency, prioritized the latest hover position, and kept nearby cached previews visible while new frames load (@thunderhawkk).
Smoother Minimize & Restore: Preserved the native video surface while minimized to reduce playback stutters and unnecessary video-output resets (@thunderhawkk).

Improved End-Screen Recommendations: Added anime recommendations after the last aired episode, preloaded suggestions and artwork before entering the mini-player, and added English fallbacks for missing recommendation descriptions (@thunderhawkk).

Compact Content Advisories: Restored the compact advisory design with severity bars, badges, and animations, plus a live settings preview under Settings → Player layout → While you watch (@thunderhawkk).
Player Interface Polish: Fixed scrollbar flicker in the "About this title" dialog and removed an unwanted focus outline around the playback stage (@thunderhawkk).
Lower Anime4K Indicator Overhead: Reduced background polling when the Anime4K badge is hidden (@thunderhawkk).
Better Intro Detection: Upgraded TheIntroDB integration to its v4 API and now sends episode duration, improving intro and recap matching (@thunderhawkk).

Chapter Marks Toggle: Added a persistent "Show chapter marks on seekbar" toggle to the player's Chapters menu. The Chapters button now starts hidden in both player layouts and can be re-enabled from Settings → Player layout (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 📅 Episodes & Release Dates
items: Episode Release Countdowns: Added live countdowns for upcoming episodes across episode lists, grids, the player, and Big Picture views (@thunderhawkk).
Cinema & Digital Release Dates: Added separate movie countdowns for theatrical and digital releases, using regional dates with clearly labeled fallback countries (@thunderhawkk).
Episode Strip Previews: Added hover previews to the episode strip, with consistent air dates, release countdowns, description settings, and visible download controls (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 📂 Library & Custom Groups
items: Custom Library Groups: Create and manage groups with editable names, optional artwork, and linked MDBList or Trakt lists under Library → My Groups (@thunderhawkk).

Group Browsing & Home Pinning: Added paginated list browsing, refresh and ordering controls, and the ability to pin groups to Home. Manage pinned group names, placement, and visibility through Customize Home (@thunderhawkk).
Restored Profile Lists: Fixed a storage-key regression that could make existing profile lists disappear (@thunderhawkk).
Collection Author Credits: Saved community collections now show the original creator's name, handle, and avatar instead of your own (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 🔄 PublicMetaDB (PMDB) & Watchlists
items: Multiple Lists & Profiles: Browse multiple PublicMetaDB lists and set persistent default target lists per user profile (@comet776).
Auto-Created Watchlists: Adding your first item to a missing PMDB watchlist will now automatically create the list (@comet776).
Prevent Duplicate Continue Watching Cards: Mapped PublicMetaDB playback items to IMDb IDs, resolving an issue where duplicate Continue Watching cards would appear (@comet776).

Alternate-ID Dismissal & Progress: Dismissed Continue Watching cards now reliably stay dismissed even when progress updates under an alternate ID (such as IMDb vs TMDB), preventing dismissed titles from reappearing (@thunderhawkk).
List Button Flicker: Fixed button flicker and state sync when adding or removing titles from PMDB lists (@comet776).

sections.heading: 🌐 Metadata & Localization
items: English Fallback for Untranslated Titles: When movie or series titles lack a translation in your preferred interface language, Harbor smoothly falls back to English rather than displaying empty labels or raw IDs (@comet776).
Preserved Japanese Anime Titles: Addressed an issue where anime titles were overridden with English translations when Japanese was selected as the metadata language (@thunderhawkk).

Custom Poster Service Compatibility: Added support for Pictorium's combined ID templates, corrected series poster requests, and ensured artwork updates when the custom poster-service URL changes (@thunderhawkk).
Arabic & RTL Layout Fixes: Corrected ordering for ranking numbers, episode metadata, awards, and stream labels in Arabic and right-to-left layouts (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 🪟 Windows System Tray & Accounts
items: Theme-Aware Tray Menu: Added a custom, theme-aware system tray menu on Windows with smooth outside-click dismissal, native menu behavior, and localized preference labels (@OwaisByte).
Primary Harbor Account: Made the Harbor profile account the primary account across the app (@thunderhawkk).
Reliable Tray Preferences: Fixed unrelated tray-menu toggles unexpectedly re-enabling Pause When Minimized (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 🖥️ Interface & Navigation
items: Account Settings Landing Tab: Settings → Account now opens on Your profile, with Account provider moved after the profile tabs (@thunderhawkk).

Settings Search Focus: Settings search now draws its focus ring around the rounded field, and focus styling follows mouse, keyboard, and remote input even when TV navigation is turned off (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 🎮 Games & Launchers
items: Brand, Launcher & Platform Icons: Restored missing high-quality icons and brand marks for Steam, IGDB, Metacritic, Steam Deck, PlayStation, Xbox, Epic Games, GOG, Battle.net, EA, Ubisoft, Riot, Itch.io, and Linux platforms (@thunderhawkk).
Smart Game Matching: Improved library release matching by sanitizing source titles, accurately handling roman numerals, and recognizing special edition tags (@thunderhawkk).
Shared Sidebar Animation: The Games sidebar navigation icon now uses the shared, lightweight Lottie animation system (NavLottie), adhering to your global motion preferences (@OwaisByte).
Decoupled Quick Library: Decoupled the Quick library feature to optimize gating and reduce the overall installation footprint (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 📚 eBooks & Reading
items: Inline EPUB Images: Chapter illustrations, diagrams, and figures in EPUB books now load and render properly inside Harbor Reader (@thunderhawkk).
Book Mode Performance: Fixed a freeze where dual-page Book View could hang while preparing pages for display (@thunderhawkk).
Reader Window Controls: Fixed reader controls overlapping the application's window chrome (@thunderhawkk).
Fresh Suwayomi Chapters: Manga chapters now refresh from Suwayomi when opening a title, with a manual refresh option that keeps existing chapters visible while checking for updates (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 💬 Subtitles & Translations
items: Translating Addon Stability: Fixed translation workflows for translating subtitle addons (such as SubMaker), ensuring translated subtitle tracks complete reliably and load into the player without dropping out (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 🏠 Home & Music
items: Localized Hero Banners: Featured hero descriptions and overview text on the Home screen now accurately follow your localized hero feed (@thunderhawkk).
Persistent Music Dock: The mini music player dock now remembers its closed state across application restarts (@thunderhawkk).

Spooktober Banner Controls: Choose whether to hide the banner, keep it compact in the top-right corner, or place it below the hero under Settings → Theme & appearance → Interface → Spooktober. This setting appears during Spooktober (@thunderhawkk).
RTL Spooktober Navigation: Fixed carousel positioning, dragging, arrow controls, and keyboard navigation in right-to-left layouts (@thunderhawkk).
Independent Card Title Size: Added a separate size control for titles beneath poster cards under Settings → Theme & appearance → Interface → Title text → Card title size (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: ⚡ Performance & Desktop Stability
items: Faster Startup & Browsing: Staggered background preloading, deferred synchronization, and reduced unnecessary rendering across Home, Discover, and Library (@thunderhawkk).

More Efficient Metadata & Artwork Loading: Reduced duplicate metadata requests, improved poster loading and transitions, and optimized watchlist caching and large SIMKL history processing (@thunderhawkk).
Linux Rendering Stability: Removed problematic backdrop filters over video and Library surfaces to mitigate WebKit compositor hangs (@thunderhawkk).
macOS Window Rendering: Fixed the windowed application showing through the video when regaining focus (@thunderhawkk).

sections.heading: 🌐 Platform & Shipyard
items: New Community Domain: Migrated all community endpoints, updater references, Shipyard installer screens, Flatpak metadata, and Winget manifests to the new official domain at harborcommunity.site (@thunderhawkk).
Clean Install Option: Added Clean install to Shipyard's installation options, with explicit confirmation before removing existing application data (@thunderhawkk).
Scaled Display Support: Improved installer layout so controls remain visible on scaled displays (@thunderhawkk).
